prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A professional expressionist hand-painted GAME CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET, exactly FOUR separate full-length figures in ONE horizontal row, of the SAME elderly male Berlin building inspector. Front, strict right-facing profile, straight rear, strict left-facing profile. Ordinary REALISTIC ADULT BODY PROPORTIONS, six and a half heads tall, a small head, lengthy adult legs, knee joint at natural height. He is a slightly stocky 65-year-old man with modest belly, angular narrow weathered face, tired skeptical SMALL eyes, short GREY SIDE-PARTED hair, round thin BLACK glasses, small WHITE chin GOATEE. Clothing: worn MUSTARD KNITTED V-NECK VEST, GREY short-sleeved collared shirt, FULL-LENGTH DARK CHARCOAL TROUSERS, BROAD BROWN low leather shoes. His arms hang naturally at his sides, shoulders to elbows and wrists all connected. One folded WOODEN FOLDING RULER belongs ONLY to his anatomical RIGHT hand low beside the right thigh; his anatomical LEFT hand stays EMPTY. One tiny WHITE SPIRAL NOTEPAD sticks from his anatomical LEFT BREAST POCKET. Front view ruler on screen-left, notepad on screen-right. Back view ruler on screen-right, notepad invisible. Right-facing profile near hand holds ruler, notebook far side hidden; left-facing profile near hand empty and near left breast shows white notepad, ruler partly hidden in far right hand. No copied/mirrored body orientations. Neutral planted stance with slight gap between whole shoes. All four figures same size and same ground baseline.
Paint as mature DISCO ELYSIUM meets grim Berlin street character, with expressive adult anatomy, sharp asymmetrical facial planes, furrowed brow, broad bold DRY OIL BRUSH STROKES, impasto and broken edges, grey-green and petrol blue shadows against dirty ochre. Broad painted folds, aged hands, adult facial structure. Strong painterly graphic realism rather than 3D render. No cute miniature, bobblehead, chibi, giant head, stubby legs, smooth airbrush, glossy skin, clean vector or children illustration. Head occupies only 15 percent of standing figure. Full bodies from crown through complete sole, loose margins and generous gaps. True transparent RGBA backdrop, no ground/shadow, no scene, no text, labels, grid or additional objects. Closed resting lips visibly defined on front and both profiles, back has no face.

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Paint exactly FOUR NEW WHOLE-BODY diagonal turnaround views of the SAME elderly Berlin man in the reference, in ONE horizontal row with transparent gaps. Reference is the exact identity, mature adult proportions and expressionist oil-painted finish authority. Preserve its long adult legs, small angular aged head, tired stern face, grey side-part hair, round black glasses, small white chin goatee, modest belly, mustard knitted V-neck vest, grey short sleeves/collared shirt, full charcoal trousers, broad worn brown shoes. Same one adult body scale and ground baseline. Left to right EXACTLY: FRONT-RIGHT 45 degrees (body/head/pelvis/feet all turned halfway between viewer and screen-right); REAR-RIGHT 135 degrees (turned away toward screen-right, mostly back with narrow right cheek edge); REAR-LEFT 225 degrees (turned away toward screen-left); FRONT-LEFT 315 degrees (halfway between viewer and screen-left). Genuine four separately painted oblique bodies, not front-facing shoulders under swiveling heads, not mirrored cardinal poses. Show full crown through whole attached shoes; neutral planted stance, small relaxed shoe gap, arms low. Both thighs/knees/calves and shoulder/elbow/wrist chains connected. Do not change height, head size, clothes, facial structure or painting texture as he rotates.
The ONE folded WOODEN FOLDING RULER stays in his anatomical RIGHT hand low at right thigh. The LEFT hand remains EMPTY. The ONE small WHITE SPIRAL NOTEPAD stays in anatomical LEFT BREAST POCKET. FRONT-RIGHT: right hand with ruler is near on screen-left; pocket far on screen-right may partly occlude. REAR-RIGHT: right hand/ruler near on screen-right, back dominant, pocket naturally hidden. REAR-LEFT: ruler remains far right hand on screen-right partly obscured by body, near left hand on screen-left empty; pocket hidden. FRONT-LEFT: near LEFT hand on screen-right EMPTY, white notepad near LEFT breast pocket visible; ruler in far RIGHT hand on screen-left may be partly hidden. Do not multiply props or swap hands, do not place notebook in a hand. No extra objects.
Preserve the reference's rough angular DISCO ELYSIUM expressionist OIL PAINT finish, broad directional brush planes, weathered adult skin and eyes, dirty ochre and petrol/grey-green shadows, no toy or glossy 3D smoothness. Closed visible lip creases on front quarters, no frontal mouth on rear views. Actual transparent RGBA canvas in margins and gaps. No painted backdrop, ground, cast shadows, text, labels or grid. Generous margins; none of the four figures touch.
